Bug_Title: UwF: Field only ever set to null (UWF_NULL_FIELD)
Bug_Details:
All writes to this field are of the constant value null, and thus
all reads of the field will return null.
Check for errors, or remove it if it is useless.
Bug_Explanation: The field 'uselessField' is only ever set to null. The'setUselessField' method accidentally sets it to a non-null value, which is the bug.
Trigger_Explanation: The testUselessField method in the UWFNullFieldBugTest class calls the showBug method of the UWFNullFieldBug class, which sets the uselessField to a non-null value. However, the assertNull method in the testUselessField method expects the uselessField to be null, causing the test to fail and triggering the bug.
